a. Running away; स्वाहोद्द्रावाय [[Vāj. 22. 8.]] 
-वः Flight, retreat; [[P. III. 3. 49.]]

A kind of aquatic animal. (Mar. जलमांजर). 
-द्रम् Water.

उद्रङ्कः,
 
-गः 
__1 N. of the town of हरिश्चंद्र (floating in the air). 
__2 Probably a tax on permanent tenants; [[GI. III. 126 ff.]]

[उद्गतो रथो यस्मात्] 
__1 The pin of the axle of a carriage. 
__2 A cock.

(chiefly used in pass.) 
__1 To excel, surpass (with abl.); ममैबोद्रिच्यते जन्म … तव जन्मनः [[Mb.]] 
__2 To increase, exceed, preponderate. उत् सहस्राद् रिरिचे कृष्टिषु श्रवः [[Rv. 1. 102. 7.]] 
__3 To abound in.

p. p. 
__1 Increased, excessive, abundant. 
__2 Distinct, evident. 
-Comp. 
-चित्तम् A mind abounding in (goodness &c.); [[Pañch. 1. 6. 12.]] 
-चेतस् a. 
__1 High-minded; [[Ks.]] 
__2 Intoxicated.

__1 Increase, excess, preponderance, abundance; ज्ञानोद्रेकाद्विघटिततमोग्रन्थयः सत्त्वनिष्ठाः [[Ve. 1. 23]]; गत्बोद्रेकं जघनपुलिने [[Śi. 7. 74]]; so मोह°, धन°, मद°; सुकृतोद्रेकः [[Bh. 3. 87.]] 
__2 Commencement, outset. 
__3 Prosperity (ऐश्वर्य); [[Mb. 12. 313. 17.]] 
-का The plant (महानिंब). 
-Comp. 
-भङ्गः discouraging a thing at the very beginning.
a. Enhancing or augmenting exceedingly; [[Rāj. T. 4.]]
